topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: Well, now, this is a twist o' the plowshare, isn’t it? Thought he was a squire, high and mighty, prancing about with his fancy talk. Turns out, he’s no more a squire than I’m the King’s own gardener. Reckon he’s been plucking the church’s chickens to keep his belly fat. Puts a new skin on things, don’t it? Makes you wonder what else has been as twisted as a gnarled apple tree. But I say, let the saints sort their own. We’ve enough to worry about keeping the soil fertile and the fields free of weeds. A man’s got to know his place and what he can truly reap. I reckon this friend of yours might learn that same lesson, in time.
